standard.summary: observe 只记录低显存信号
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.protect: 触发了就偏向保守预取和缓存预算，保活优先，吞吐会掉。

standard_en.summary: observe only records the low-VRAM signal
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.observe: The low-VRAM signal is only logged.
optionDescriptions.protect: Once triggered it leans towards conservative prefetching and cache budgets, favouring survival over throughput, which drops.

advanced.principle: observe 只记录低显存信号；protect 会在触发阈值时偏向保守 prefetch 和缓存预算。

advanced_en.principle: observe only records low-VRAM signals; protect leans toward conservative prefetch and cache budgets once the threshold triggers.
